identityConfidence: ORGANISATION: HIGH. Kanha Shanti Vanam is the world headquarters of the Heartfulness Institute (Shri Ram Chandra Mission), a 1,400-acre campus at Kanha village, Nandigama mandal, Ranga Reddy district, Telangana, roughly 50 km from Hyderabad and about 11 km off the Hyderabad-Bangalore national highway. Campus capacity is quoted at 100,000 participants and its accommodation already includes permanent tents. EVENT: UNRESOLVED.
